producer.method: independent original ARM instruction execution and separately observed source providers

scope: 864 bounded cases: empty/1/3 actual CCL children, page/nonpage casts, missing/present/duplicate-tag parameters, current/next identity precedence including external selected page, signed tag extremes, sorted/unsorted actual CCL ParamList. Full original syncPageParams and Page getter execute; casts/ParamList lookup bridge independently observed real canonical providers. Original exact NumericParam::setValue virtual address is a native boundary; ordered float bits/edit arguments feed separate actual pinned NumericParam calls, whose final values and call sequence are compared with compiled product. No Core binary execution, null CCL children, concurrent mutation, notification reentry, original return/layout/ABI or hardware claim.
